items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: And sometimes they would have Joe Robichaux's band, too. They would put on a battle of bands. Walter Fass Pichon and Joe Robichaux's band.

ctx.x: Were you in the WPA band?

No. Yes. That's what I was getting ready to come to. I thought it was something. Well, after we left the boat, then I got in the WPA band. Now, I wouldn't get it. That must have been in 41. In 41 or early part of 42. But I think it was in the late part of 41, around November, December. It might have been January of 42 or February. I know it was cold, see. Well, matter of fact, there wasn't I, nobody else in the WPA band. So, uh, well, I always was, I mean, I was still young. Of course, I got married then. See, I…
They give a prize or a cup or anything?
